comments.note: The developer persona (agent 3) currently places the 'self-documenting tools' sentence in its Workflow section rather than the MCP Tools section (as agents 4-7 do). The template normalizes this to the MCP Tools section for consistency. The Workflow section retains a slightly different version of the sentence as unique prose.

The {{#if self_documenting_note}} conditional is used in agents 3-7 templates even though all 5 have self_documenting_note: true. This is intentional — it preserves the build script's ability to toggle this block per-agent without touching the template.

3-developer.md: correct partial chain (mcp-intro → conditional self-documenting note → preflight → conditional detect/verify → unavailable → handoff)

comments.note: 1-planner.md is clean: {{> agent-roster}} placed at the natural end of the Mission block, no MCP partials at all. The template reads as pure-prose + single roster injection.

3-developer.md correctly chains partials: mcp-intro → #if self_documenting_note (mcp-tools-note) → mcp-preflight-header → #if has_detect_project (detect + verify-with-detect) → mcp-unavailable. Conditional ordering is sensible and readable.
PM (agent 2) correctly uses preflight-verify-no-detect (Step 1, no detect) and omits the has_detect_project conditional. This is the right design for the single agent that skips the detect step.
